# Media Cheat Sheet

> A searchable directory of up-to-date social media and advertising specifications. Download ready-to-use templates with safe zones for any size. Filter by platform, content type, format or aspect ratio, then copy a direct link to share with clients and designers for easy collaboration. Over 179 specifications across 17 platforms.

## How It Works

- Pick your platform: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, X (Twitter), Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Etsy, Google Ads, Reddit, Spotify, Discord, Mastodon, Bluesky, Twitch, Snapchat.
- Filter by content type: Stories, Reels, Posts, Carousel, Header, Profile, Covers, Ads, Thumbnails and more.
- Combine filters: narrow down by aspect ratio, update date, or format.
- Multiple platform selection: Use the advanced filter to select multiple platforms.
- Search instantly: type what you need and find it immediately.
- Copy & share: grab specs or send direct links to teammates.
- Download templates: SVG files with safe zones for design work.
- Quick Filters: Easily filter by the most commonly used specifications.
- Specifications are updated regularly.

## Who Uses This

- Designers – Skip the guesswork. Get precise specifications for client work.
- Marketers – Create briefs faster. Keep campaigns consistent.
- Content creators – Post perfectly sized content across all platforms.
- Agencies – Share specs instantly. No more “what size was that again?” Slack messages.
